d: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

As an Account Manager at Talabat, you will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with our restaurant and vendor partners. You will serve as the main point of contact, helping them optimize their presence on our platform, grow their sales, and ensure a high level of partner satisfaction.
Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing restaurant and vendor partners.
Ensure high partner satisfaction and retention through proactive communication, support, and service excellence.
Serve as a trusted advisor, providing partners with insights that support their business growth on the platform.
Analyze sales, operational, and engagement data to identify areas for improvement in menu performance, pricing, promotions, and delivery logistics.
Share actionable recommendations based on performance metrics to drive revenue and efficiency.
Conduct regular business reviews to align on results, opportunities, and growth plans.
Identify growth opportunities within the portfolio – upsell services, suggest cross-promotions, and improve partner performance.
Support partners in optimizing content (e.g., menu structure, images, delivery times) for better customer engagement and conversion.
Recommend and coordinate marketing campaigns and promotional offers to drive order volume.
Collaborate closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Logistics, and Operations to address partner needs and resolve issues promptly.
Ensure smooth onboarding, campaign execution, and issue resolution for assigned accounts.
Negotiate and renew commercial agreements to ensure a fair and strategic partnership.
Ensure partners comply with service-level agreements and maintain operational standards, including delivery quality and availability.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, or Partner Success (experience in food tech, FMCG, or e-commerce is a plus).
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data dashboards and Excel/Google Sheets to analyze performance and generate insights.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Customer-first mindset with a strong focus on delivering value to partners.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Fluency in Arabic Language is a must

d: The Marketing Assistant Manager is a pivotal role within KFC Marketing team, responsible for executing campaigns, promotions, and new product launches flawlessly, supporting brand strategy while protecting store operations and guest experience.

The role aims to drive brand growth, market share, and consumer engagement by collaborating with cross-functional teams and ensuring seamless execution of marketing initiatives. A key focus is driving sales growth across all channels, including aggregators, through strategic planning, data-driven decision-making, and precise, on-time execution.
q: Ensure every KFC guest enjoys a memorable brand experience through value-driven and relevant marketing initiatives.
Enhance consumer perception of KFC versus competitors through meaningful and innovative brand activities.
Monitor guest feedback, ratings, and reviews across channels (including aggregators and social media) and use the insights to improve campaigns and the guest experience.
Collaborate with the regional MENA team to adapt and localize product and innovation calendars for the regional market.
Support the development and launch of new products and campaigns tailored to local customer needs and market trends.
Monitor and analyze consumer insights to keep brand decisions aligned with customer preferences.
Support profitability for all products and campaigns, balancing brand objectives and customer satisfaction.
Manage assigned budgets and project timelines to ensure cost efficiency and effectiveness.

Build and maintain performance dashboards using analytics and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel, Google Analytics) to track campaign, channel, and aggregator results and turn data into clear recommendations.
Use AI tools to accelerate consumer insight analysis, competitor benchmarking, and the creation of campaign proposals, briefs, and presentations, with human review for accuracy and brand compliance.
Prepare data-backed proposals and business cases for campaigns, promotions, and aggregator plans, including ROI forecasts and post-campaign evaluations.

Apply digital and marketing technology (CRM, loyalty and digital ordering platforms, marketing automation, social listening, A/B testing) to personalize communications and improve conversion and retention.
Use AI and customer data responsibly, in line with KFC policies and data protection requirements.
Engage with internal teams and stakeholders to foster creativity, innovation, and strategic alignment.
Act as a brand champion, inspiring teams to uphold KFC’s values and objectives.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
An MBA or master’s degree is a plus.
4–6 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in the QSR, FMCG, or agency sector.
Prior experience in campaign execution or brand management is highly preferred.
Proven experience working with aggregator platforms and managing channel-specific growth strategies.
Regional exposure or familiarity with the GCC, and wider MENA markets is an advantage.
Fluency in English and spoken Arabic is required (Arabic speaking is a must).
Effective communication, negotiation, and networking skills.
Ability to analyze and optimize channel-level performance, including aggregators.
Creative mindset with the ability to develop engaging social media content and campaigns.
Excellent project management skills, including managing multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail, with a proven ability to launch projects and campaigns within very tight timelines without compromising quality.
Strong proposal-writing and presentation skills, including building persuasive, data-backed PowerPoint decks.
Proficiency in digital marketing and CRM tools.
Advanced data analysis skills (Excel and Power BI) with the ability to turn insights into actionable recommendations.
Hands-on experience with AI tools for analysis, content, and proposal creation, with sound judgment on accuracy and data privacy.
r: Assist in developing and implementing short- and long-term brand strategies to achieve business objectives, including transaction growth, sales volume, and profitability.
Support the execution of marketing campaigns at market, Emirate, and store levels.
Continuously analyze brand performance and recommend strategies to address challenges and seize opportunities.
Conduct competitive analysis to guide marketing plans and maintain KFC’s competitive edge in the quick-service restaurant (QSR) industry.
Develop and execute long-term and monthly visibility plans with aggregator platforms to drive sales growth.
Monitor and analyze channel-level performance to identify opportunities for growth across delivery, dine-in, takeaway, drive-thru, and aggregator channels.
Collaborate with aggregators to optimize visibility, promotions, and campaigns tailored to KFC’s target audience.
Ensure alignment between marketing initiatives and aggregator-specific strategies to maximize return on investment (ROI).
Work closely with cross-functional teams (such as Operations, Revenue Management, Supply Chain) to ensure alignment and successful execution of marketing plans.
Manage the briefing, development, and implementation of advertising, promotions, media planning, POS materials, and packaging.
Partner with agencies and suppliers to execute campaigns effectively, on time, and within budget.

Launch campaigns, promotions, and projects within very tight timelines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail in every execution, including pricing, offers, creative, legal copy, and aggregator content.

Coordinate campaign readiness with Operations and Supply Chain before every launch (stock availability, store capacity, team briefing, and POS and aggregator set-up) to protect store operations and the guest experience.
Monitor live campaigns and resolve issues quickly (e.g., pricing errors, stock-outs, or aggregator content gaps), then report results and lessons learned to improve future launches.
Ensure all marketing materials and promotions comply with KFC brand standards and applicable advertising, media, and consumer protection regulations.

d: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cybersecurity Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of technical expertise, hands-on operational experience, and leadership capabilities, with a proven track record in designing, implementing, and managing cybersecurity programs across complex environments.

This role requires a strategic thinker who can also operate at a deep technical level, lead security teams, and work closely with executive leadership, clients, and stakeholders to ensure robust cybersecurity posture and compliance with local and international standards.
Lead and manage end-to-end cybersecurity operations , including SOC, incident response, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management.
Design, implement, and continuously improve information security frameworks, policies, and procedures .
Oversee risk assessments, penetration testing, and security assessments , ensuring timely remediation.
Manage and respond to cyber incidents , leading investigations, root cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.
Ensure compliance with regulatory and industry standards (e.g., NCA, ISO 27001, NIST, SAMA, PCI-DSS).
Collaborate with internal teams and clients to align cybersecurity strategies with business objectives.
Lead, mentor, and develop cybersecurity engineers and analysts.
Evaluate, implement, and manage security tools and technologies (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, DLP, IAM, etc.).
Prepare executive-level security reports, dashboards, and risk summaries .
Stay up to date with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and cybersecurity trends.
5–12 years of experience in cybersecurity or information security roles.
Proven experience in security architecture and security controls design .
Solid understanding of GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) .
Experience working with enterprise and government environments is a strong plus.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders .
Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
Cloud Security certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP Security) are a plus
Any NCA-related or local regulatory certifications are a plus
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field
Work with a leading cybersecurity organization in the region
Engage in high-impact, national-level and enterprise cybersecurity projects
Continuous learning, certification support, and career growth
Collaborative, innovative, and professional work environment
